scope: Exact compact presentation only; no row exclusion or norm evaluation.

normCircuit.companionConvention: For q=X^d+sum(q[k]*X^k,k<d), C[k+1,k]=1 and C[k,d-1]=-q[k]; all other entries zero.
normCircuit.canonicalRelations: For active J, set inactive u_i=0, and use det(G_j(C_(g/X))) for j in J; impose T=0 separately.
